versions.changelog:
Initial release – create 3D models from photos or text prompts as GLB files.

- Converts single or multiple reference images, or a text description, into a game/AR/print-ready 3D model.
- Supports multiple model backends (Rodin Gen-2, Meshy-6, Hunyuan 3D, Tripo 3D) with customizable settings per output target.
- Output is a textured mesh with configurable topology, polygon budget, and materials (PBR or baked).
- Advanced controls for rigging, animation poses, texture quality, and mesh detail.
- Detailed workflow and parameter documentation included for reliable, production-ready asset creation.
